title: Severe bleeding
summary: Stop the bleeding before anything else.

steps.text: Call 911 if you have signal. If not, send someone for help and prepare to move the casualty.
Find where the blood is coming from. Open or cut away clothing to see the wound.
Is the wound on an arm or leg?

ask.q: Is the wound on an arm or leg?

steps.text: Put a tourniquet 2 to 3 inches above the wound, not on a joint. Tighten until the bleeding stops, then start a timer.
If bleeding continues, add a second tourniquet above the first. Do not loosen or remove a tourniquet; leave that to medical staff.
Neck, shoulder or groin: pack the wound tightly with gauze or clean cloth, then press hard with both hands.
No gauze or cloth: press firmly and steadily on the wound with both hands and do not let up.

sources.name: Stop the Bleed (American College of Surgeons, Committee on Trauma)
